summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Event Scout Auto-Scan features. All 20 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: (1) GET/PUT /api/admin/event-scout/sources for config management, (2) POST /api/admin/event-scout/scan-now for manual trigger, (3) Event Scout 3 tabs UI (Search, Saved, Auto-Scan), (4) Config tab with sources, keywords, toggle, scan button, (5) Perplexity API key field in Admin Settings, (6) Public Agenda page, (7) Event CRUD operations.
